criteria.name: Persuasiveness of the speech
criteria.description: Assign the official WUDC speaker score from 50 to 100 for the speaker's contribution. Judge persuasiveness as an integrated assessment of the plausible reasons showing that arguments are true and important (analysis or matter) and the clarity and rhetorical power with which those reasons are explained (style or manner). The official manual expressly says analysis and style are not separate scoring criteria, so no invented split is used.
